### Test Cases Based on Functional Requirements | **Test Case ID** | **Description** | **Pre-conditions** | **Action Steps** | **Expected Result** | |-------------------|-------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------| | TC-01 | Test Successful Login with Valid Credentials | - User has valid login credentials (username: saucelinux, password: password123) | 1. Enter login credentials (username: saucelinux, password: password123)
2. Click "Login"
3. Verify that the user is redirected to the home page | - User is redirected to the home page with successful login | | TC-02 | Test Unsuccessful Login with Invalid Credentials | - User has invalid login credentials (username: invalid, password: invalid) | 1. Enter invalid login credentials (username: invalid, password: invalid)
2. Click "Login"
3. Verify that an error message appears indicating login failure | - Error message appears indicating login failure | | TC-03 | Test Adding a Product to the Cart | - User is on the home page and sees the "Products" section | 1. Click on a product (e.g., "Braised Chicken")
2. Click "Add to Cart"
3. Verify that the product is added to the cart with a quantity of 1 | - Product is added to the cart with a quantity of 1 | | TC-04 | Test Viewing the Cart with Added Product | - User has added a product to the cart | 1. Click on "Cart" in the navigation bar
2. Verify that the cart icon appears and the product is listed with quantity 1 | - Cart icon appears and product is listed with quantity 1 | | TC-05 | Test Adding Multiple Products to the Cart | - User is on the home page and sees the "Products" section | 1. Click on "Braised Chicken" and click "Add to Cart"
2. Click on "Braised Chicken" again and click "Add to Cart"
3. Verify that the cart shows "Braised Chicken" x2 | - Cart shows "Braised Chicken" x2 | | TC-06 | Test Checking the Cart for Added Products | - User has added multiple products to the cart | 1. Click on "Cart" in the navigation bar
2. Verify that all added products are listed with correct quantities | - All added products are listed with correct quantities | | TC-07 | Test Proceeding to Checkout Process | - User has added products to the cart | 1. Click on "Shopping Cart" in the navigation bar
2. Click on "Continue to Checkout"
3. Verify that the checkout page loads successfully | - Checkout page loads successfully | | TC-08 | Test Providing Personal Information During Checkout | - User is on the checkout page and enters partial information | 1. Click on "Continue to Checkout"
2. Enter first name: John
3. Leave last name field empty
4. Click "Submit"
5. Verify that an error message appears indicating missing last name | - Error message appears indicating missing last name | | TC-09 | Test Completing Checkout with Required Information | - User is on the checkout page and enters all required information | 1. Click on "Continue to Checkout"
2. Enter first name: John
3. Enter last name: Doe
4. Enter email: john.doe@example.com
5. Click "Submit"
6. Verify that a confirmation message appears indicating order processing success | - Confirmation message appears indicating order processing success | | TC-10 | Test Completing Checkout with Missing Information | - User is on the checkout page and enters incomplete information | 1. Click on "Continue to Checkout"
2. Enter first name: John
3. Leave email field empty
4. Click "Submit"
5. Verify that an error message appears indicating missing email | - Error message appears indicating missing email | These test cases cover the functional requirements identified and provide a clear structure for testing each feature of the SauceDemo website.
